mapper.insert: INSERT INTO first_bloods (question_id, contest_user_id, user_id, bonus_awarded) VALUES (#{questionId}, #{contestUserId}, #{userId}, #{bonusAwarded})
mapper.select: SELECT fb.question_id AS questionId, q.title AS questionTitle, q.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, q.points AS points, fb.user_id AS userId, u.student_id AS studentId, u.full_name AS fullName, fb.achieved_at AS achievedAt FROM first_bloods fb LEFT JOIN questions q ON q.id = fb.question_id LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = q.category_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = fb.user_id ORDER BY fb.achieved_at ASC
